name: Laminar
oneLine: Open-source agent observability platform: traces, evaluations, SQL access and LLM-based failure detection (Signals).

selfHostStack.value: Docker Compose: frontend, app server, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Quickwit. Helm adds RabbitMQ, Redis, a consumer

selfHostLicence.value: Apache 2.0. Signals, clusters, email and Slack alerts need an enterprise licence key when self-hosted

cloudFree.value: Free plan, $0/month: 1 GB data, 7-day retention, 1 project, 1 seat

cloudPaidFrom.value: Pro: $30/month with 3 GB data included, then $2/GB; 3-month retention; Signals billed per token

otel.value: OTLP over gRPC and HTTP; gen_ai semantic conventions; self-hosted ports 8001 (gRPC) and 8000 (HTTP)

sql.value: Yes: SQL editor in the UI, POST /v1/sql/query API, CLI and MCP; SELECT only

mcp.value: Yes: run read-only SQL, manage Signals and LLM profiles, tag traces; some tools cloud-only

onlineEvals.value: Signals: an LLM agent analyses finished traces against plain-language instructions, with triggers and sampling

datasetsExperiments.value: Yes: datasets with versioned datapoints, evaluations SDK with run comparison, agent evaluations via CLI

alerts.value: Per-Signal alerts: in-app, email, Slack; triggered by a new event or a new cluster

issueDetection.value: Signals detect events in traces with an LLM; events are grouped into clusters by meaning, up to three levels

annotationQueues.value: Labeling queues: reviewers edit, approve or discard items from spans, datapoints or SQL; approved items go to a dataset

assistant.value: Laminar Agent: panel in the app, also Slack, MCP and CLI; queries your data, builds dashboards and opens pull requests

codingAgents.value: Plugin for Claude Code; integration pages for Codex, OpenCode and Pi

chooseThem: Failure signals written as plain-language instructions, with triggers, trace filters, sampling and alerts
Agent debugger (record, replay) and agent-evaluation tooling, with docs for browser agents
SQL over traces from the UI, API, CLI and MCP, plus dashboards
A managed cloud with usage pricing and a free tier, and Apache 2.0 code you can self-host
